rows.abstract: Aims to provide an alternative to the ROTC program as a requirement for graduation in a baccalaureate degree. rows.abstract: "Government Reorganization Act of 1995" Is premsised on the need to make the government bureaucracy more efficient and effective in order to assist in national development efforts.
